text:
jana: New customer ran our quickstart from the README and saw the sample chat return text, but the very next embeddings call failed with a 401 citing workspace billing. They were confused because the UI said "trial active".

jana: Their sanitized curl:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_zzz" -d '{"model":"embed-mini","input":["hi"]}'
```

omar: If chat was routed to trial sandbox and embeddings hit real provisioning checks, you can see inconsistent behavior. Quickstarts sometimes hit two different backend paths which has bitten us before.

pat: Important DX note: our Node quickstart has a global retry that treats 401/402 like transient. That makes the sample app hang because it retries for ~6s. We should change the retry to immediately surface billing-related 4xx.

devex-bot: Runbook: https://console.redwood.ai/onboarding-runbook#billing. Suggest adding a preflight call that checks workspace readiness.

support_bot: Workaround provided to customer: have workspace owner accept billing/verify card, or create a temporary dev workspace to finish the quickstart. I attached TKT-8142 for follow-up.

jana: Proposal: quickstart does a single /v1/onboarding/check at startup. If response shows billing_not_ready -> show clear banner with console link and skip embeddings demo. Also update SDKs to make 401/402 with reasons starting with "org.billing_" non-retriable.

omar: I'll open a tiny changelist for the quickstart UI and a Node SDK PR to treat those reasons as terminal. Labeling owners: @omar (quickstart), @pat (sdk). ETA 48h.

pat: I'll also add a small unit test to ensure we don't retry when body contains "billing" clues and that the error includes help_url if present.

jana: Customer verified billing and finished onboarding. Leaving a note to docs to add a short troubleshooting bullet under "first successful call".

devex-bot: Tags: @sdk-team @quickstart @support.
